# Named Attribute

Reads a stored value by name so you can use it to control your edits.

`lfs.named_attribute` · Input

## How to use

Enter the exact attribute name and choose its type.  
A missing attribute cannot provide values.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name | `Name` | lfs.string |  | — | Exact stored attribute name, including case. Empty by default; enter a name before using the output. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Attribute | `Attribute` | lfs.float | — | — | Values read from the named attribute, in its stored units. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type | `type` | enum | float | float; int; bool; vector; colour | Stored value type to read. Float, the default, reads one decimal value per element. |
